name: rtk
description: Install, initialize, verify, and troubleshoot RTK (Rust Token Killer) for AI coding agents. Use when you need to reduce shell-command token output, confirm that the correct `rtk` binary is installed, choose between Homebrew, install.sh, or Cargo installation, wire `rtk init` for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, or OpenCode, or use compact wrappers such as `rtk git status`, `rtk read`, `rtk grep`, `rtk test`, `rtk lint`, and `rtk gain`. Triggers on: rtk, rust token killer, token saver cli, rtk init, rtk gain, codex rtk, gemini rtk, opencode rtk, claude hook token reduction.
author: akillness
